create_DetectionCheckpointer: create a DetectionCheckpointer instance to handle model checkpoint loading and saving with distributed data parallel support
load_DetectionCheckpointer_checkpoint: load a model checkpoint from a file path supporting Detectron2, Caffe2, and pycls checkpoint formats
handle_DistributedDataParallel_load: handle distributed checkpoint loading by verifying file availability across all workers before loading

ignore_missing_pixel_mean_pixel_std: ignore missing pixel_mean and pixel_std keys during checkpoint loading since they are initialized from config
